core_obligations: Spell out the precise statement: with the lower shriek of the composites written via the composition equalities, the outer exchange map must equal the composite of the two square exchange maps (proof lines 2913-2924).

Represent the maps: choose the two-step K-injective resolution and recall from the proof of the exchange lemma that both square maps are given by quasi-isomorphisms of complexes (proof lines 2925-2941).

Conclude: by exactness of g_! the composite map is a quasi-isomorphism representing the rectangle's exchange arrow, and it is manifestly the composition of the two square maps (proof lines 2942-2951).
